title: QUIZ - 67
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Interpret the meaning of the constant term in a quadratic real-world model as the initial value
questions.question: A ball's height in meters is modeled by \( h(x) = -3x^2 + 2x + 1 \), where x is time in seconds. What does the constant 1 represent in this context?

options.label: A
options.text: The time at which the ball hits the ground.

options.label: B
options.text: The speed at which the ball was thrown.

options.label: C
options.text: The ball's maximum height.

options.label: D
options.text: The ball's initial height (its height at time zero).

questions.explanation: Evaluating h(0) = -3(0)^2 + 2(0) + 1 = 1, so 1 represents the initial height of the ball, before any time has passed.
questions.hint: Consider what the formula evaluates to when the input variable equals zero.

questions.learningObjective: Interpret the meaning of the constant term in a linear real-world model
questions.question: In the model \( C = 37x + 54 \) for the cost of a service, where x represents the number of hours, what does the number 54 represent?

options.label: A
options.text: The maximum number of hours allowed.

options.label: B
options.text: The total number of hours worked.

options.label: C
options.text: The fixed cost that is charged regardless of the number of hours.

options.label: D
options.text: The cost per hour of service.

questions.explanation: In C = 37x + 54, 37 is the rate multiplying the variable (cost per hour), while 54 is added regardless of x, making it the fixed cost.
questions.hint: The constant term in a linear model represents the value when the variable is zero — the fixed, unchanging part.

questions.learningObjective: Interpret the meaning of the coefficient in a linear real-world model
questions.question: In the model \( C = 44t + 90 \) for the cost of a service, where t represents the number of hours, what does 44 represent?

options.label: A
options.text: The number of hours already worked.

options.label: B
options.text: The cost per hour (the rate at which cost increases per additional hour).

options.label: C
options.text: The fixed cost charged regardless of hours.

options.label: D
options.text: The total cost for all hours combined.

questions.explanation: The coefficient 44 multiplies t (hours), representing how much the cost increases for each additional hour: the rate.
questions.hint: The coefficient of the variable represents the rate of change per unit of the variable.
